operator_instances.title: The Held Interval
operator_instances.meaning: A measured gap: ache, pause, or what has not yet been decided. It is not a connection.

operator_instances.title: The Conditional Gate
operator_instances.meaning: A conditional opening. An open gate is not proof that anyone crossed.

operator_instances.title: The Countertrace
operator_instances.meaning: A counterreading: a risk the upright text warns against. It has not been established as fact.

legend.intro: Codex of Becoming is a new visual grammar for this installation. It is not original canon, not a historical occult system, and not a claim that these shapes were already in the 78. A painted glimmer is not a join. Only a listed CONTACT mark is a stored meeting.
legend.contact_note: No CONTACT glyph. The stored graph did not authenticate a join, so none was drawn.
